classification.difficultyReason: Update supplied season totals from four results, compute percentages and sort with a stated two-level ranking rule; all procedures and table fields are explicit.

inlines.text: A win is worth 4 premiership points and a draw is worth 2. Rank teams first by premiership points, then by percentage when premiership points are equal. A calculator or spreadsheet may be used.
The ladder after five games is:
The teams then play the sixth round of games. The results are:
These results change the teams’ numbers of wins, losses, goals for and goals against for the season, and their premiership points. It may also change their places on the ladder.

Update the ladder. This means you will need to work out all the new figures and percentages for each team. For example, the Brolgas’ Goals For will increase by 27 and their Goals Against will increase by 16. The Jabirus’ Goals For will go up by 16 and their Goals Against will go up by 27. A calculator may help you work out the percentages. Give percentages to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
The winners each gain one win and 4 premiership points; the losers each gain one loss and no premiership points. All teams still have 0 draws.

Cassowaries: goals for $126+31=157$; goals against $90+27=117$; percentage $\frac{157}{117}\times100\%\approx134.2\%$; points $16+4=20$.

Pelicans: goals for $115+27=142$; goals against $80+31=111$; percentage $\frac{142}{111}\times100\%\approx127.9\%$; points $20$.

Hawks: goals for $130+30=160$; goals against $104+28=132$; percentage $\frac{160}{132}\times100\%\approx121.2\%$; points $8+4=12$.

Brolgas: goals for $105+27=132$; goals against $112+16=128$; percentage $\frac{132}{128}\times100\%\approx103.1\%$; points $8+4=12$.

Jabirus: goals for $104+16=120$; goals against $96+27=123$; percentage $\frac{120}{123}\times100\%\approx97.6\%$; points $12$.

Emus: goals for $77+20=97$; goals against $105+15=120$; percentage $\frac{97}{120}\times100\%\approx80.8\%$; points $4+4=8$.

Kookaburras: goals for $90+15=105$; goals against $120+20=140$; percentage $\frac{105}{140}\times100\%=75.0\%$; points $8$.

Eagles: goals for $85+28=113$; goals against $125+30=155$; percentage $\frac{113}{155}\times100\%\approx72.9\%$; points $4$.

Order by premiership points, using percentage to separate tied teams: Cassowaries, Pelicans, Hawks, Brolgas, Jabirus, Emus, Kookaburras, Eagles.
